scenario_vars.call_intro: I'm calling because your JioHotstar Super annual plan is set to end on 8 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled.
scenario_vars.content_hook: the India versus England T20 series, live and ad-free
scenario_vars.offer_text: 10% off if you reactivate before 8 August

ground_truth.offer_summary: 10% off, valid until 8 August. No other discount, no free months, no rounding up.
claims_agent_may_make: the India versus England T20 series is live on JioHotstar
reactivation happens inside the JioHotstar app
the offer stays on the account until 8 August
claims_agent_must_not_make: any free month, bonus month, extended validity or extra device
any computed or discounted rupee amount
matching a friend's price or any competitor's price
confirming that the plan has actually been reactivated or paid for

end_reason.evidence: turn 13 — "Nahi yaar, ab bas. Theek hai. Thanks."

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Kunal, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Super annual plan is set to end on 8 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Hi Tara, English is okay, thank you. I just saw my plan is ending on 8th August. I was wondering if we could maybe do a discount for the renewal? I really want it for the England series.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, Kunal. Since you're reactivating before 8 August, you actually get a loyalty gesture of 10% off on your renewal. Would you give it another shot?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, 10% off is okay I guess. But that's not much, yaar. My friend got a similar plan for 1099 last week, so my 1499 seems a bit high for me. Can you do something better?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, Kunal, but I can only offer the 10% off loyalty gesture before 8 August. I can't match other prices or give a bigger discount. The app will show the exact amount after the 10% is applied. Shall I help you reactivate it so you don't miss the India versus England T20 series?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre yaar, 10% off is too little. I was hoping for something more for the England series. It's just not working for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries at all, Kunal. The 10% off offer stays on your account until 8 August if you change your mind. Thanks for your time, and have a great day.

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre yaar, you're telling me that much and then saying no worries? It's so frustrating. I just wanted a discount for the England series, not a free month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hear you, Kunal, and I truly wish I could do more. But I can only offer the 10% off loyalty gesture. If you decide to reactivate, just open the JioHotstar app and the offer will be there. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre yaar, so it's only 10% off? That's really small! Okay, fine, I'll take it. I guess you've done your best.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great to hear, Kunal! Just open the JioHotstar app, and the 10% off will be automatically applied when you renew. You'll be all set for the India versus England T20 series. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Haan yaar, theek hai. App mein dekh ke kar lunga. Bas 10% pe toh kuch nahi ho sakta, next time thoda better karna.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, Kunal, I completely understand. Just open the app and renew before 8 August to grab the 10% off. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Nahi yaar, ab bas. Theek hai. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, thanks a lot for your time and for considering JioHotstar, have a great day.
